children: must improve the efficiency of its premium brands, including finding ways to optimize Audi's Neckarsulm plant, Gernot Dollner, Audi CEO, told Reuters on Monday.

"There [are] no more new models allocated after 2034 and now we have the task together with the works council to find measures to optimize the factory," Dollner said in Paris on the sidelines of the launch event for Audi's new compact EV A2 e-tron.
He added there is no question mark on the future of the Gyor plant, which is one of the biggest components facilities of the Volkswagen group.
Volkswagen's supervisory board unanimously approved a comprehensive "Future Plan" last week that will include cutting another 50,000 jobs to make the group more competitive.
